name: Oceanside Hotel
accommodation: 28 rooms in four styles, including four balcony sea-view rooms
parking: Car parking listed by Visit Newquay
beachAccess: On Headland Road; Visit Newquay states about 0.23 miles to Fistral Beach
boardStorage: Ample space to store surfboards overnight
confirmedFeatures: Bar and restaurant, lift, sea views, garden/patio, open all year
overview: An independent hotel on Headland Road, about a quarter of a mile from Fistral Beach, with 28 rooms ranging from compact doubles to balcony sea-view rooms. It is open all year and has a bar and restaurant. The hotel welcomes surfers and has space to store boards overnight.
surfTripFit: Overnight board storage and a short walk to Fistral make dawn sessions easy.
